lines.en: I flick my tail and swim over.
I turn a small circle in the water.
I slide along the rock face.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流的缝往里钻。
lines.en: I slip into a gap in the current.
I sink a block slowly.
I swim toward the light.
I swim past my shoal.
I glow as I swim.
I move from the dark toward the light.
I circle a stalactite.
I edge toward the surface.
I rise and fall with the water.
I swim a little your way.
I flick my tail as I turn.

lines.zh: 我摆着尾，从钟乳石底下溜过。
lines.en: Tail flicking, I slip under a stalactite.
I head deeper.
I swim slowly along the cave wall.
I hold in one layer of water.
I hold still, my glow faint.
I sway my tail in the water.
I press to a stone and hold.

lines.zh: 光在我背上，慢慢地呼吸。
lines.en: The light on my back breathes slowly.
I wait for the water to move.
I crowd in among my shoal.
I am almost invisible.
I glow in a dark spot.

lines.zh: 我收紧腹鳍，停在水的中间。
lines.en: I fold my belly fins and hold mid-water.
I hang there, a tiny point.
I rest by the weeds.
I sway gently with the water.
I hold still, conserving effort.
I wait for other fish to move first.

lines.zh: 我停在你手指边上，不游了。
lines.en: I stop beside your finger and hover.

lines.zh: 你一只手掌就能把我盖住。
lines.en: One of your palms could cover me.

lines.zh: 我退到你的影子外面去了。
lines.en: I back away beyond your shadow.
My light falls on your hands.
I slip away along the stone.
I circle once beside you.
I am not afraid, only careful.
My body is thin as a needle.
I stop in the water and look.
I flash once your way.
I dart half a block away.
My light goes out for an instant.

lines.zh: 我一头钻进石缝，光也藏好。
lines.en: I dart into a crack and hide my glow too.
I flee a short way.
I pull all my fins in.
I press to the stone and stay still.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我掉了一片鳞。
lines.en: One hit knocks a scale loose.
I swim back into the shoal.

lines.zh: 我缩回石缝，只露一点光。
lines.en: I shrink into the crack with only a spark showing.
My glow comes back a little.
I swim toward that speck.
I circle it halfway.
I bite; it is too small.
I swallow it in one go.
I nose up against it.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，我一口啐回水里。
lines.en: This tastes wrong, so I spat it straight back into the water.
I swim off and come back.
I push it against a stone.
I pay it no more attention.
I head for another glimmer.
You touch me and I dart away.
I drift half a block from the push.
I press against your hand.
I dart behind a stone.
The water stirs once.

lines.zh: 你手一拨，我翻着漂了出去。
lines.en: A flick of your hand sends me tumbling away.
My light flickers.
I barely feel the bump.
I swim back into the shoal.

lines.zh: 被水推得转了半圈，我才停住。
lines.en: The current spins me half around before I stop.
I slip between your fingers.
I hit a stone and veer off.
Two small fish press together.
We swim a tiny ring.
Its glow meets mine.
We swim up together.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一块石头边。
lines.en: We crowd by the same stone.
They swim one behind the other.
Neither of us drifts off.
Our lights join into a small patch.
We slip into a stone crack together.
We are both small and quiet.
I hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 它卡在我嘴里，我游不快。
lines.en: It is stuck in my mouth and I cannot swim fast.
It is bigger than I expected.
I swim a while with it.
I hide it under a stone.
I try to swallow and get stuck.
I let go and it drifts away.
I swim two circles around it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴拱了拱沙，把它埋住。
lines.en: I nudge the sand with my mouth and bury it.

lines.zh: 我一边游一边回头看它。
lines.en: I swim on and look back at it.

lines.zh: 我借着一股水流，往前挪了挪。
lines.en: Riding a thread of current, I edge forward.

lines.zh: 水纹一散，我的光就亮起来。
lines.en: The ripples spread and my glow comes up.
I begin swimming faster.
I spread my fins.

lines.zh: 我身上的光，忽然亮了一格。
lines.en: The light on me jumps up a notch.
I have picked that small speck.
I come at it from another angle.

lines.zh: 我压着沙面，贴着水底滑过去。
lines.en: Hugging the sand, I glide along the bottom.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一点一点凑近。
lines.en: Mouth open, I inch closer.
No hurry; the water is still.
I follow that small shadow.
It moves and I turn.
I hold this distance throughout.

lines.zh: 我从石头的背面绕了过去。
lines.en: I slip around the back of the stone.
I approach it from below.
My tail never stops.

lines.zh: 我停在缝口，把光探进去一点。
lines.en: I hover at the crack and push my glow inside.

lines.zh: 我顺着草叶的缝隙，一点点凑过去。
lines.en: Through the gaps in the weeds, I creep closer.

lines.zh: 那个影子已经到我嘴边了。
lines.en: That shadow is right at my mouth now.
I dare not move too fast.
I take a gentle bite of it.

lines.zh: 我用小脑袋顶了它一下。
lines.en: I butt it with my little head.
My mouth is small but quick.
I flick my tail at it.
I dart up from below.
It gets flipped by my nudge.
I bite and pull back.

lines.zh: 我撞上它的鳍，被弹了回来。
lines.en: I bump its fin and bounce back.
I hold on with my teeth.
It slipped away from me.
A small light appears in the water.
I swim out of a crack in the rock.
A shoal of small fish swims in.

lines.zh: 这里的暗处亮了一小块。
lines.en: A patch of the dark lights up.
I break the surface once.

lines.zh: 你脚下的水里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves in the water at your feet.
I begin swimming in these waters.
A wide spread of small lights rises.

lines.zh: 一点小光，从黑水里冒了出来。
lines.en: A small light rises out of the black water.
Fine ripples cross the surface.
The surface heats and I sink.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩出去，摔在石头上。
lines.en: I am thrown out of the water onto stone.

lines.zh: 我在水里忽然喘不上气。
lines.en: I suddenly cannot breathe in the water.

lines.zh: 炸响过后，我在水面上打转。
lines.en: After the blast I spin on the surface.
An arrow goes right through me.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的光按灭了。
lines.en: That force snuffs my light out.
I am too small to last long without food.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整个人一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I lock up.

lines.zh: 下面的水没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The water below is gone; I fall.
